opening: Myth or fact? A twenty-five percent markup means a twenty-five percent margin.
instagram:
Myth or fact? A 25% markup means a 25% margin.

Myth. Margin divides profit by the selling price; markup divides it by cost. Cost AED 100, price AED 125: markup 25%, margin 20% (illustrative).

Markup: profit ÷ cost
Margin: profit ÷ price
For a 25% margin, mark up by 33.3%
